title: Debug symbols
summary: Debug symbols from Debian for the programs of the box (nginx, Kiwix, mosquitto). With them, the backtraces of gdb show function names and lines. The toolkit has symbols for the installed programs only. Estimate: about 14 MB for all of them.
consent: These packages come from the debug archive of Debian (debian-debug). The box checks them with the same signed indexes as the rest of Debian. Debug-symbol packages do not replace the executable programs. They let a debugger read the programs.
notes: The packages come from the debug archive of Debian. The box checks them with the keys of Debian. It keeps the index of the archive apart from the other package lists.
The symbols of a program must match its version exactly. After you update a program, download the toolkit again.
Use it with gdb from the Debugging toolkit. Optional large packages: libicu76-dbgsym and libxapian30-dbgsym (25 MB, for the search of Kiwix) and systemd-dbgsym (7 MB).
